svg.text: Full A4 Blueprint: Java 25 | Spring Boot 4.x | Angular 19 (Signals & SCSS) | Keycloak OAuth2 | Strict Database-per-Service (MySQL)
1. CLIENT PRESENTATION LAYER — ANGULAR 19 (STANDALONE COMPONENTS, SIGNALS STATE, SCSS)
Interactive Leaflet.js with dynamic tile rendering
Hourly, Daily, Overnight & Monthly rental plans
One-tap handoff to Google Maps external intent
Address, GPS pin placement, slot dimensions, rules
Front/back NID, flat allotment slip & garage photos
Configurable hourly, daily, overnight & monthly rates
Target monthly earnings: ৳3,000 to ৳8,000 per slot
Digital pass lookup by license plate (Zero guard barrier)
Automated flag on vehicles exceeding reserved hours
Immutable logging of state changes & financial records
2. EDGE ROUTING, RATE LIMITING & IDENTITY INFRASTRUCTURE
Spring Cloud Gateway (Edge API Gateway - Port 8080)
• Centralized Single Point of Entry for All Client Requests
No internal microservices exposed directly to the public internet
• Centralized RS256 JWT Token Validation Filter
Validates Keycloak signatures, parses claims, strips unauthenticated calls
- /api/v1/users/** -> Routed via Eureka to User & KYC Service (:8081)
- /api/v1/parkings/**-> Routed via Eureka to Parking Spot Service (:8082)
- /api/v1/bookings/**-> Routed via Eureka to Booking Service (:8083)
• Token Bucket Rate Limiting (DDoS & Coordinate Scraping Defense)
Industry-standard token issuance, claims generation, and refresh lifecycle
Signed with Keycloak private key; verified across Gateway using public key
• Unified Dual-Role User Model (One login for drivers & hosts)
Single user identity holds both ROLE_VEHICLE_OWNER & ROLE_SPOT_OWNER
• Role Hierarchy: ROLE_VEHICLE_OWNER, ROLE_SPOT_OWNER, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_GUARD
KEYCLOAK IAM | PORT: 8180 | RS256 OIDC TOKENS
3. SERVICE REGISTRATION & DECLARATIVE INTER-SERVICE RPC BUS
• Dynamic Registry: Automatic 30-second heartbeat health monitoring
• Zero Hardcoded IPs: Microservices communicate via logical service IDs
• Fault-tolerant registry with auto-eviction of unhealthy service instances
• Synchronous Declarative REST Clients with Resilience4j Circuit Breakers
• Booking-Service -> User-Service (Validate KYC status & vehicle registration)
• Booking-Service -> Parking-Service (Query slot availability & trigger locking)
4. APPLICATION BUSINESS LOGIC TIER — SPRING BOOT 4.X MICROSERVICES (JAVA 25)
Full name, phone, emergency contact, role state
Encrypted multipart upload: NID, Tax Slip, Photos
Exposes internal endpoints for booking validations
Hourly, Daily, Overnight & Monthly rates for Car/Bike
Generates verification token, spot ID & license plate
@Scheduled runs every 5 min; detects overdue vehicles
6. EXTERNAL INTEGRATIONS, PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT & ARCHITECTURE SPECIFICATION
Zero-cost mapping tiles rendered via Leaflet
Captures user coordinate with zero app install
Zero foreign keys across microservice schemas
Isolated containerization for all services & DBs
HTTPS REST / JSON Client Request Flow
